newsitem.title: USA: Toyota designs car with cheaper motor - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Toyota designs car with cheaper motor - WSJ.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp will introduce a car in Japan next month that will be equipped with an engine that costs a third less to produce, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday.
The newspaper said the company was not disclosing any details about the new car except that it had a third fewer parts to it.
It said Ryuji Araki, the company's finance director, had confirmed that Toyota was looking at axles, transmissions and other parts of a car in an effort to further reduce production costs.
The newspaper said industry experts speculated that the new car probably only had an old push-rod engine compared to the overhead-cam technology engine found in most vehicles today.
